title: IceTrail+
description: FrostRunner Abilities gives you powerful items like Ice Trail, Boat Spawn, and TNT Summon
body:
# ⚠️ **Important Warning** ⚠️ 

This data pack will automatically delete all items in your hotbar and offhand and replace them with its own ability items.

# ❄️**IceTrailPlus**❄️

_IceTrailPlus_ expands your Minecraft experience with new, action-packed abilities!

Earn special items like Ice Trail, Boat Spawn, and TNT Summon, which grant you unique powers:

Ice Trail – Create an icy trail as you walk, clear blocks, and gain a short burst of speed.

Boat Spawn – Instantly spawn boats and use them flexibly for fast travel.

TNT Summon – Summon TNT right in front of you – perfect for battles or creating mayhem!
